scope: study design only; no manufacturing geometry or foundry access claim

preconditions: Select exactly one accessible and licensed process for each submitted design; do not put SOI and TFLN on a single die without an established heterogeneous process.
Obtain official current layer map, process rules, MPW eligibility, and DRC/DFM acceptance from the facility.
Confirm usable wavelength band, polarization/mode, optical coupling arrangement, available laser detector meter OSA and coherent receiver if phase needed.
Create unambiguous per-die structure identifiers, GDS source hashes, port labels, design and as-fabricated geometry records.
Pre-register exact lengths/radii, wavelengths, repeats, measurement uncertainty methodology and acceptable confidence thresholds before manufacture.
sequence: instrument baseline and source power drift checks
fiber or edge alignment and polarization check
I/O back-to-back reference repeated before and after each device group
spectral acquisition with repeated devices and controls
derive loss and ratios with propagated uncertainty and residual diagnostics
independent review of exact geometry-to-measurement mapping
do_not_infer: intrinsic microring Q from system power notches
physical loss of one interface without a defensible two-interface model
manufacturer DRC clearance from generic geometric checks

structures.hypothesis: Separate propagation-dependent loss from coupling and common-path loss.
readouts: transmitted optical power versus wavelength
power versus independently measured path length
regression slope dB/cm and residuals
controls: at least three distinct lengths and independent input/output reference structures
identical input/output coupling geometry and routing as far as physically possible
structures.design_action: new process-specific cutback set; earlier SiEPIC measured spirals are an external reference, not the same geometry

structures.hypothesis: Determine excess loss attributable to bends relative to matched straight reference.
readouts: transmitted optical power versus wavelength
incremental insertion loss per bend with uncertainty
controls: multiple repeated bends and matched-length straight controls
same optical I/O and polarization
pitfalls: bend transition and straight loss not isolated
structures.design_action: new matched-radius SOI bends; design/process rule review required

structures.hypothesis: Quantify four-port power split and excess loss across wavelength.
readouts: bar and cross output powers
normalized split fraction
total collected output power relative to matched reference
optional complex S only with separately calibrated coherent phase
controls: both input ports separately where accessible
straight-through optical I/O reference
required_metadata: input launch power at each reference plane
pitfalls: missing fourth port or uncollected radiation
structures.design_action: place same-revision original four-port BDC in matched I/O test harness

structures.hypothesis: Characterize passive interference fringe contrast and spectral period.
readouts: output power spectrum at both outputs
fringe extinction and free spectral range
relative arm group-delay estimate conditional on known topology
controls: matched-path reference MZI and one deliberately imbalanced MZI
independently characterized splitters and optical I/O
required_metadata: as-designed and as-built optical path difference
pitfalls: fringe contrast conflates loss mismatch and splitter imbalance
no phase reconstruction from intensity alone
structures.design_action: reuse parent MZI architecture only as layout starting point; remove heater for passive test or document if retained unpowered

structures.hypothesis: Determine fiber-to-chip or chip-to-chip interface loss without assuming a generic coupler placeholder.
readouts: fiber-to-fiber transmission spectrum
repeatability across alignments
inferred per-interface loss only under verified symmetry
controls: identical back-to-back couplers with known route length
independent light-source and receiver power reference
pitfalls: two-coupler loss cannot be uniquely split absent symmetry
structures.design_action: paired grating input/output reference structures; do not import 4.1 dB family figure as calibrated device value
